part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Newspapers and Magazines
questions: Which magazines and newspapers do you read? [Why?]
What kinds of article are you most interested in? [Why?]
Have you ever read a newspaper or magazine in a foreign language? [When/Why?]
Do you think reading a newspaper or magazine in a foreign language is a good way to learn the language? [Why/Why not?]

part2.topic: Describe a restaurant that you enjoyed going to.
points: what type of food you ate in this restaurant
part2.closing: and explain why you enjoyed eating in this restaurant.

topics.title: Restaurants
questions: Why do you think people go to restaurants when they want to celebrate something?
Which are more popular in your country: fast food restaurants or traditional restaurants? Why do you think that is?
Some people say that food in an expensive restaurant is always better than food in a cheap restaurant – would you agree?

topics.title: Producing food
questions: Do you think there will be a greater choice of food available in shops in the future, or will there be less choice?
What effects has modern technology had on the way food is produced?
How important is it for a country to be able to grow all the food it needs, without importing any from other countries?

issues: Speaking Part 2: the book typesets the word 'and' at the end of the third cue-card point ('what type of food you ate in this restaurant and' / 'explain why you enjoyed eating in this restaurant.'); it is placed at the start of 'closing' ('and explain why you enjoyed eating in this restaurant.') as in the other tests. No wording changed.
